text: The DELETE request is routed to the endpoint that matches the URL `/api/posts/10/`; the server uses that URL alone to locate the specific post because each endpoint is defined by a unique URL that can accept different HTTP methods, including DELETE [2]. When the request reaches the view, the view extracts the identifier (`10`) from the path and looks up the object (e.g., via `get_object_or_404`) without needing any additional data from the request body [1]. Thus the resource is identified solely by the URL present in the current request.
